title: Dalrymple, Ontario and South Australia readings join their Atlas pages
summary: One project and two place accounts retain local, metropolitan, provincial and state boundaries. Their exact reviewed narratives now lead the existing Atlas pages, with five explicit links between related but separate scopes.
